title: merremia quinquefolia
intro: Merremia quinquefolia, commonly known as five-angled glory bower or five-leaved glory bower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Convolvulaceae. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Merremia quinquefolia include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
